name: nuxt
description: Nuxt is a free and open-source framework with an intuitive and extendable way to create type-safe, performant and production-grade full-stack web applications and websites with Vue.js.

cves.summary: Nuxt vulnerable to remote code execution via the browser when running the test locally
Nuxt allows DOS via cache poisoning with payload rendering response
Nuxt has Client-Side Path Traversal in Nuxt Island Payload Revival
nuxt vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting in navigateTo if used after SSR

readme.summary: Well-structured high-level overview with clear installation and a basic example, but defers nearly all depth to external docs with minimal in-README examples, no configuration docs, and no troubleshooting.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section and no configuration documentation — common problems and setup options are entirely absent, requiring users to leave the README immediately.

common_complaints: Error messages not showing actual errors (regression)
Module import complexity and documentation clarity
sentiment.summary: Nuxt shows moderate maintainer engagement with active issue triage, but slow response to help requests and legacy automated issues left unresolved for years.

red_flags: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed for complex issues
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful, clear, patient, and technically sound. They encourage new contributors but could benefit from more detailed explanations in some cases.

concerns: 908 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months - serious backlog accumulation
Zero merged PRs in past 6 months indicates development has stalled
Zero active contributors in past 6 months despite large issue queue
Unknown last release - unclear what version users should depend on
Contradictory data: recent commit but no 6-month activity suggests isolated fix after long dormancy
positive_signals: Very recent commit on 2026-03-16 indicates some minimal activity
maintenance.summary: Nuxt appears minimally maintained with a recent isolated commit, but shows clear stagnation over 6 months with massive unresolved issue backlog and no active development or contributor engagement.

risk_factors: Publisher 'GitHub Actions' not in maintainers list

concerns: SUPPLY CHAIN: Accessing .npmrc (npm tokens) in dist/index.mjs
Communication: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed for complex issues
Supply Chain: Publisher not in maintainers list
highlights: Frequent commits (300 in the past 6 months)
High number of merged PRs (247 in the past 6 months)
